messages:
mira: Heads-up — experimenting w/ an 'Autopilot' fallback policy editor in the console. Prototype includes a 'degrade preference' slider (latency vs quality) and automatic trigger rules. Thoughts on auditability? :thinking:

jules: Important: every automated fallback decision needs to emit a signed audit event with policy_version + reason_code. SREs need human-readable reasons to triage.

kai: Agree. Also want a dry-run preview in the editor that shows which historical requests WOULD have fallen back. Can we reuse the playback sim infra?

matt: @deploy-bot can we include short request hashes in the audit events so we can map them back to logs without storing PII?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: policy_autopilot_v2 pushed to staging at 1758524708 :white_check_mark:

jules: Example policy payload we prototyped:
```
{
  "name":"autopilot-v2",
  "triggers":[{"type":"error_rate","threshold":0.03},{"type":"latency","p50_ms":1200}],
  "degrade":{"mode":"graceful","target_model":"small-quant"}
}
```

mira: This looks good but defaults were a bit aggressive in our sim — it caused oscillation on the canary. Need hysteresis and a minimum hold_time (e.g., 5m) before allowing another switch.

kai: UI idea: show 'expected cost delta' and 'expected latency delta' for each degrade option, plus a tiny sparkline preview. Also add an explicit escape-hatch button that documents which route it'll switch to.

matt: Ops requirement: quota-aware triggers. If a customer tier doesn't allow fallback to a paid model, the policy must respect that. Expose `customer_tier` as a condition in the trigger DSL.

jules: Audit log format proposal: `policy_id,policy_version,trigger,reason_code,decision_ts,request_refs[]` — and keep request_refs as short hashes only (no prompt text).

mira: Retention question: current thinking 90 days is fine, but enterprise customers will request configurable retention (longer). Make retention per-org configurable and surfaced in the console.

kai: Also add a 'simulated rollback play' feature: replay a historical window and overlay simulated policy decisions on the latency/cost dashboard so PMs can eyeball impact.

matt: Agreed. Next steps: jules update audit schema + sample events, kai wire the preview sim into the console, mira add UI copy for hysteresis/hold_time. I'll open an RFC and canary the editor in staging.

jules: On it — will post the schema PR and link the sim stub. :rocket:
